item.title: Fixing PHP 'Creating Default Object From Empty Value' Warning
item.description:
“Fixing PHP ‘Creating Default Object From Empty Value’ Warning”

Encountering the “Creating default object from empty value” notification in PHP signifies an attempt to assign a property to a variable that is either NULL or not an object. This issue frequently arises due to evolving error reporting levels in PHP, moving from E_STRICT in older versions (<= 5.3.x) to E_WARNING in PHP 5.4 and later. How do we reliably prevent this notification while maintaining clean, modern PHP code?
